resumen: Standing at the high pulley, the elbow opens downwards with the upper arm against your side.
ejecucion: Stand facing the pulley and take the bar with hands shoulder-width apart.
Tuck your elbows against your sides with your forearms at chest height.
Straighten your elbows, driving the bar towards your thighs.
Return under control until the forearm passes horizontal.
The upper arm does not move: if the elbows drift forward, you are pushing with your chest.
matices: With the arm at your side the long head of the triceps starts shortened and contributes less than in the overhead versions — which is what the cited work measures. In exchange it is the easiest to do well and the one that best allows adding load gradually.
